+title: MultiTool conforms to GraphQLEndpointTool and gives the endpoints of its capabilities
+---
+## What
+Per EXTRAS-7 / D82 (TestudoApp `features/packages/foundationmodels-extras.md`), the top-level `MultiTool` tool (`runCode`) conforms to `GraphQLEndpointTool` and gives the endpoints of its capabilities. APP-16 reads endpoints only from the top-level tool list, so this is the **only** way the app finds `snapshots` (MT-13), `files` (MT-11) and `settings` (ACPA-17 mounts `SettingsTool` with `withOperationTool`, not as a top-level tool).
+
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Surface/Capability.swift`: add `var graphQLEndpoints: [any GraphQLEndpoint] { get }` to `Capability`, with a protocol-extension default that collects `(tool as? any GraphQLEndpointTool)?.graphQLEndpoints` over `tools`. `OperationToolCapability` (`Surface/OperationToolCapability.swift`) gets this for free because `tools == [tool]`.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/MultiTool.swift:325`: `MultiTool: GraphQLEndpointTool`; `graphQLEndpoints` gives the endpoints of every capability in the current registry, in registry order. Remove repeats by `(name, scope)`; the first one wins (the D77 rule of the host).
+- Endpoints are read when the host asks, so an MCP registry swap does not keep stale endpoints.
+
+Conventions: EXTRAS-9 (TestudoApp `features/packages/foundationmodels-extras.md`, D115).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `MultiTool` is `GraphQLEndpointTool`; a cast from `any Tool` succeeds
+- [ ] A capability whose tool conforms to `GraphQLEndpointTool` gives its endpoints through `MultiTool.graphQLEndpoints`
+- [ ] An operation tool mounted with `withOperationTool(noun:tool:)` that conforms (like `SettingsTool`) gives its endpoints
+- [ ] Two endpoints with the same name and scope give one entry, the first
+- [ ] A registry with no endpoint gives `[]`
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/MultiToolGraphQLEndpointsTests.swift`: stub endpoint + stub `GraphQLEndpointTool`, cases for capability, operation tool, repeats, empty
+- [ ] `swift test --filter MultiToolGraphQLEndpointsTests` passes; `swift build` with no warnings
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #graphql
\ No newline at end of file
